verdict.rationale: Alloy is a KYC/AML and fraud compliance platform, so a human approval gate before filing a regulatory report (e.g., a SAR) is a fair axis. However, the evidence never documents regulatory report submission or an authorized-approval step before one. Mentions of manual reviews, investigations and 'auditable agentic automation' are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
